additional_concerns: Neither candidate has executable meaning. Retrieval PASS results locate passages only; the LegalRuleML result establishes no preservation or legal sufficiency.

Retained accountability, supervisory conduct and operational outcomes require separate findings. The supplied text provides no complete fulfillment test, incident tolerance or assessment period; missing facts cannot be treated as failure.

The substantive candidate combines paragraph 10 with the separate proper-records and operational-compatibility requirement. This is a rival reading, not an established equivalence, and section 6.11C supplies no automatic tokenisation supervision standard.

Paragraph 14's request phrase directly qualifies demonstration. Footnote 5 supports both the harmonised reading and the preserved literal alternative; neither absence of a request nor confirmation establishes substantive compliance or SFC satisfaction.

Paragraph 15 concerns requested third-party audit or verification of three specified subjects; paragraph 16 concerns a requested legal opinion supporting the application. Neither creates an unconditional procurement requirement.

The complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and applicable Appendix factors are not supplied. The high-confidence smart-contract language must not automatically become the standard for every responsibility or record-keeping duty.

Section 6.8 separately requires notification of register locations on request. Intermediary paragraph 18 separately addresses understanding controls before relevant activities. Neither should silently become a Product Provider retention test.
